translation_fidelity_review.summary: Fresh cross-model translation-fidelity audit (Codex GPT-5.5 xhigh, read-only, fresh thread). Codex independently read the Chinese source of truth (docs/tutorials/attention_tutorial.md), the English translation (docs/tutorials/attention_tutorial_en.md), and the rendered English HTML (docs/tutorials/attention_tutorial_en.html), then compared EN against ZH across all five fidelity axes: (a) numbers/formulas/code/tensor shapes, (b) citations (author/year/venue) and model names, (c) completeness (no dropped section/claim/caveat, no new hallucinated claim), (d) terminology consistency, and (e) HTML
